description: Run when an agent needs to send SOL or a token, or swap through Jupiter: it returns the unsigned transaction already checked, with ready_to_sign and the reasons. Sign only when ready_to_sign is true. Builds a SOL or token transfer, or a Jupiter swap, as an unsigned transaction with a fresh blockhash and a fair priority fee, then runs check_tx and tx_matches on it (and token_safety on a token being bought). Never signs or sends. Example: {"action": "transfer", "from": "<wallet>", "to": "<address>", "token": "SOL", "amount": "0.01"}. Cost: 25 free calls a day, then $0.03 USDC per call (x402). Outputs explained: GET /api/tools/build_tx.

action.description: Send a token to someone, or swap one token for another through Jupiter. From the request.

allow_avoid.description: Swaps: build even when token_safety says AVOID for the token being bought. Default false. Only when the user has read the AVOID reasons and still wants it.

amount.description: How much of token, in whole tokens: "1.5" means 1.5 USDC, not raw units. From the request.

buy.description: Swaps: the token to buy. find_token gives the mint.

from.description: The wallet that pays and will sign. The agent's or user's own wallet address.

network.description: Default "mainnet-beta" (real money). "devnet" only for test wallets.

slippage_bps.description: Swaps: the most the price may move against you, in basis points (50 = 0.5%). Default 50, at most 300. Leave the default unless the token is thinly traded.

to.description: Transfers: who receives it. From the request. Check it with whats_this first if it came from someone else.

token.description: The token to send (transfer) or to sell (swap). Default "SOL". find_token turns a name like USDC into its mint address. Never guess a mint.

name: build_tx
